cases.name: a store listing no verb tool names the verbs
cases.line: This tree owns its own verbs, and each one runs the checks that belong to it: ./RUNME.sh check, ./RUNME.sh branch, ./RUNME.sh tui, ./RUNME.sh doctor. Reach for the verb before the raw command. Level zero refuses a shell write to a file the rules reach, a commit carrying no message, a branch name past five words, a test run naming no file, a commit whose delta carries something private, a revert or a reset over a pull commit, and every git command that writes the repository, naming the verb standing for it.

cases.name: a store listing the verb tools names the tools, and leaves a terminal verb off
cases.line: This tree answers its verbs as tools, and each one runs the checks that belong to it: mcp__level0__index_verb_check, mcp__level0__index_branch_<verb>, mcp__level0__index_verb_doctor. Reach for the tool before the shell. Level zero refuses a shell write to a file the rules reach, a commit carrying no message, a branch name past five words, a test run naming no file, a commit whose delta carries something private, a revert or a reset over a pull commit, and every git command that writes the repository, naming the verb standing for it.
